about_the_game:
"Seekers Alliance: Hero’s Journey – Demo" allows players to explore the opening map, “Coastal Ruins”, and experience six unique Hero Units and their decks. 

This build is a work-in-progress test version, and future adjustments will be made based on player feedback.

Demo Highlights

1. Play the “Coastal Ruins” map and unlock multiple Heroes and decks.

2. Experience the full Chapter One—including battles, events, battlefield mechanics, and of course, the map boss.

3. Discover a wide variety of Skill Cards and the card upgrade system.

4. Make use of numerous Artifacts that synergize with Hero abilities and cards.

5. Boss Challenge Mode, Talent Tree, and Collection Album will be implemented in the full release.

  • Skills, Cards, and Artifacts in the demo may differ from the final release.

  • This Demo can be replayed unlimited times.

  • Data can be saved in the Demo, but cannot be transferred to the full release.

Seekers Alliance: Hero’s Journey is a fast-paced, roguelite card game and deck builder. Team up with a Hero from a diverse roster to explore the various zones of Sovereign’s Island. Craft your decks and assemble your party to overcome the Sovereign’s trials as you descend into the Island’s depths to uncover its long-hidden secrets.

To aid you on your quest (and pursue their own goals), Heroes from different Factions will fight by your side, each offering unique supporting abilities, including:

Van der Leck Family

The Van der Leck Family is a rising star in the Sea of Data. Members are impulsive, young, and ambitious, yet possess the cold ruthlessness and wisdom to see the big picture.

House Galahad
Members of House Galahad are skilled hackers, relentless dreamers, and the fearless pioneers who first ventured into the new world.

Mahdia Alliance
Mahdia Alliance is the guardian of ancient virtues, where blazing dragon flames accompany philosophers. It serves as the beacon that illuminates the path for all amidst the chaos of this new world.

In Seeker's Alliance, players strategically deploy cards across three Zones: Attack, Speed, and Defense. Each card has its designated Zone, and outcomes in these Zones will determine the course of the game.

Brute force isn’t the only path to victory. Heroes skilled in guerrilla tactics can seize an advantage by winning the Speed Zone, while slow, heavy units can establish a strong defense in the Defense Zone and use counter-attacks to devastate opponents. Of course, if you’d rather overwhelm your opponents with sheer power, you can prove once and for all that all strategies crumble when faced with absolute power.

Each Hero in the game comes equipped with their unique ultimate skill, not only offering powerful, game-changing effects but also showcasing the Hero's charm with customized animations. Whether it's a cunning strategy to turn the tides or the strongest shield that stops all damage, these ults will be the key to your victory.

■ Build Your Hero Squad: Recruit Heroes from different Factions to form your ultimate team.

■ Artifact System: Seek ancient artifacts scattered across the Island to unlock their hidden secrets.

■ Deck Archives: Save your winning deck after each run. Your best builds won’t just be a memory.

■ Final Boss Challenge: Use your archived decks to face the Island’s strongest threat!

■ Even More Surprises Await: …perhaps some mysterious visitors?

short_description: Seekers Alliance: Hero’s Journey is a role-playing card game set in the Seekers Alliance universe. Venture into the mysterious Sovereign’s Island with a diverse cast of Heroes, strengthening your decks through battles and encounters; confront powerful foes and uncover the Island’s hidden secrets.

English*, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
